Yw.bar_b_note: Flat pale sky, smeared low-res ground and no fog, shafts or time-of-day grade sink it; only B's aftermath storytelling (banners down, captive freed, smoking collapsed tent) approaches a shipping game.

Vt.bar_b_note: The lightning-streaked wolf model, fur and scale beside the ruler carry it; A's belly-up faint roll is the weak point.

Gv.bar_b_note: Readable warm face, clear eyes and an earthy olive-and-brown outfit in the key-art palette carry it, though the soft cartoon face sits a step away from the naturalistic creatures.

Tg.bar_b_note: An appealing fennec model with a clear scarf accent carries it; A's 'faint' frames, which show it sitting upright, would not pass in a shipping game.

Vd.bar_b_note: The thick white fur with blue markings and the big silhouette carry it; A's sit-up faint and B's fully airborne hit react weaken it.

Kv.bar_b_note: A naturalistic rosette-patterned snow leopard at Palworld-class scale carries it; A's faint end is a seated pose and B's hit react is a pounce-like leap.

Ex.bar_b_note: The ram model matches the style bar, but A's belly-up flip appears lifted off the floor and B's horns stretch into long tubes in the faint frames, which sinks the finish.

Qz.bar_b_note: Same white wolf as Vd: the model and fur carry it, and A's seated faint plus B's airborne hit react hold it back.

Mm.bar_b_note: A good ram model, but A's rolled belly-up body appears raised above its shadow and B's horns deform into long curling tubes when it faints.

Wd.bar_b_note: A's smooth clay-like boar with stuck-on moss reads as a placeholder; B's furrier body is closer, but its yellow leopard spots are off-board, its faint frames look lifted over a blurred shadow and it barely reaches the ruler's height.

top_changes.change: Re-author hit-react and faint animations so they read without a label and stay grounded: no seated 'faint' (Tg, Vd, Qz, Kv, Wd side A), no fully airborne leap as a hit react (Vd, Qz, Kv side B), no belly-up roll (Vt, Ex, Mm side A), and fix the horn skinning that stretches the ram's horns (Ex, Mm side B).

Meadows aftermath and world finish: on every after frame, take down or topple the red enemy banners and leave one site-specific remnant; replace the smeared ground texture with clustered grass, flowers and dirt-path edges; add a clouded blue sky, warm sun grade and distance fog so the shots match the key art.
Rebuild the Wd boar's material as real fur in the board's brown, with moss accents, and scale it so it stands above the 1.80 m trainer.
